definition: Quality improvement is deliberate change aimed at making an object, process, or system better at meeting relevant quality needs or requirements.
explanation: An improvement effort should identify what is to change, the desired result, and evidence that could show whether the change helped. A revised procedure alone does not show that performance improved.

Improvement can address recurring failures, strengthen a process, or add capabilities that meet changing needs. Evidence of the resulting effect distinguishes an achieved improvement from an intended one.
